example: {year} CRC §R319.2.1 for a dwelling, or {year} CBC §1005.3.2
notes:
Section numbers for the 2025 California codes. The 2025 CRC is based on the 2024 IRC, which renumbered Chapter 3. Use these numbers; the 2022 numbers shown in parentheses are wrong for this edition, even if the plans or a standard comment still use them.
- Unchanged: fire-resistant construction R302 (exterior walls R302.1, two-family dwellings and ADU separation R302.3, garage openings R302.5, garage separation R302.6, under-stair protection R302.7).
- Site address R308 (was R319). Automatic sprinklers R309, one- and two-family dwellings R309.2 (was R313.2). Smoke alarms R310: location R310.3, near cooking appliances R310.3.1, interconnection R310.4 (was R314). Carbon monoxide alarms R311, location R311.3 (was R315).
- Minimum room areas R312 (was R304). Ceiling height R313 (was R305). Habitable attics R316 (was R326). Garages and carports R317, garage floor R317.1, garage door openers R317.4 (was R309).
- Means of egress R318: egress door R318.2, landings at exterior doors R318.3, hallways R318.6, stairways R318.7, risers and treads R318.7.5, landings for stairways R318.7.6, stair handrails R318.7.8, stair illumination R318.7.10, spiral stairs R318.7.11 (was R311).
- Emergency escape and rescue openings R319: minimum size R319.2.1, minimum dimensions R319.2.2, maximum sill height R319.2.3, area wells R319.4, replacement windows R319.5 (was R310).
- Handrails R320: height R320.2, clearance R320.4, continuity R320.5, grip size R320.6. Guards R321.1: height R321.1.2, opening limits R321.1.3. Window fall protection R321.2 (was R312).
- Elevators and platform lifts R323. Glazing R324: hazardous locations R324.4, skylights R324.6 (was R308). Light, ventilation and heating R325: habitable rooms R325.1, bathroom exhaust R325.2, required heating R325.8 (was R303). Toilet, bath and shower spaces R327 (was R307). Aging-in-place design R328 (was R327). Decay protection R304 (was R317). Termites R305 (was R318). Flood-resistant construction R306 (was R322).
- Chapters 1 and 4 through 9 keep their numbers: R106 construction documents, R401 to R408 foundations and under-floor space, R506 slabs, R602 wall framing, R602.10 wall bracing, R703 exterior coverings, R802 roof framing, R806 roof ventilation, R807 attic access, R902 roof classification, R905 roof coverings.
- Wildland-urban interface: the 2025 cycle moved the construction requirements into the new California Wildland-Urban Interface Code (CWUIC, Title 24 Part 7). CRC R337 and CBC Chapter 7A now only point to it. Cite the CWUIC for WUI items, written like "2025 CWUIC §504.8": Class A roof 504.2, roof covering airspace 504.2.1, valleys 504.2.2, enclosed eaves 504.3, unenclosed eaves 504.3.1, gutters 504.4, exterior walls 504.5, underfloor enclosures 504.6, decks and projections 504.7, exterior glazing (multipane with at least one tempered pane) 504.8, exterior doors 504.9, garage door battery backup and gaps 504.9.1 and 504.9.2, vents 504.10, accessory buildings 504.11, roof covering replacement 507.1, access roads and addresses 403, vegetation management 603, spark arrestors 605, LP-gas tanks 606. Ask the applicant to note the Fire Hazard Severity Zone on the first sheet.
- The 2025 CBC uses ASCE 7-22 for loads. Existing buildings cite the 2025 CEBC.

notes: Section numbers for the 2022 California codes. The 2022 CRC follows the 2021 IRC numbering: fire-resistant construction R302, light and ventilation R303, minimum room area R304, ceiling height R305, toilet and bath spaces R307, glazing R308, garages R309, emergency escape and rescue openings R310 (opening area R310.2.1, sill height R310.2.2, area wells R310.4), means of egress R311 (landings R311.3, stairways R311.7), guards and window fall protection R312, sprinklers R313 (one- and two-family R313.2), smoke alarms R314, carbon monoxide alarms R315, decay protection R317, site address R319, flood R322, aging-in-place R327, and exterior wildfire exposure R337 (CBC Chapter 7A for other buildings). The 2022 CBC uses ASCE 7-16 for loads.

example: {year} IRC §R319.2.1 for a dwelling, or {year} IBC §1005.3.2
notes: Section numbers for the 2024 I-Codes. The 2024 IRC renumbered Chapter 3: site address R308, sprinklers R309, smoke alarms R310, carbon monoxide alarms R311, minimum room areas R312, ceiling height R313, garages R317, means of egress R318, emergency escape and rescue openings R319 (minimum size R319.2.1, sill height R319.2.3, area wells R319.4), handrails R320, guards and window fall protection R321, glazing R324, light, ventilation and heating R325, toilet and bath spaces R327, decay protection R304, termites R305, flood R306. R302 and Chapters 4 through 9 keep their numbers. Wildland-urban interface items follow the International Wildland-Urban Interface Code where the jurisdiction adopted it. The 2024 IBC uses ASCE 7-22.
